title: GTA6 Original Soundtrack Revealed with 34 Songs
description: GTA6's original soundtrack has been partially revealed by Eurogamer, featuring 34 tracks with real-world artists and six streaming now.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Original Soundtrack Partially Revealed: 34 Tracks and Six Streaming Now

The anticipation surrounding Grand Theft Auto 6 continues to grow as new details emerge regarding the game's audio design. According to a recent report by gaming media outlet Eurogamer, Grand Theft Auto 6's original soundtrack has been partially revealed, offering a glimpse into the musical landscape of the upcoming open-world crime game.

### A Massive Musical Undertaking

Music has always played a vital role in shaping the atmosphere of the Grand Theft Auto series, from iconic radio stations to carefully curated licensed tracks. The newly detailed full album for GTA 6 contains 34 original tracks created specifically for the game. Furthermore, the soundtrack features music from multiple real-world artists, showcasing the developers' commitment to blending authentic musical talent with the game's virtual setting.

### Six Tracks Available to Stream Today

Fans eager to get a taste of the game's auditory experience will not have to wait for the full release. Alongside the partial reveal, it was announced that six of the tracks are available to stream today. This allows players to dive into the official soundscape of the upcoming title right now and speculate on how these songs will fit into the open-world experience.

As the gaming community eagerly awaits further updates from Rockstar Games, the reveal of this 34-song original soundtrack highlights the immense production value being poured into GTA 6.

## Editor's Take

Music is the beating heart of the Grand Theft Auto franchise. Eurogamer's report detailing the 34-song original soundtrack and the immediate availability of six tracks gives fans a brilliant early taste of what to expect. It's a smart move to let the audience experience the audio direction early, building excitement while keeping the community engaged during the wait for release.
